_comment: RU routing pipeline - sing-box server example. Placeholder tokens {{VERSION}} and {{CDN_BASE}} are substituted at build time by ru_routing.render.render_examples. node-example is a documented placeholder outbound tag: replace its address/credentials with a real inter-node deployment before use.
_bittorrent_parity_comment: NON-PARITY NOTICE: sing-box does not expose an Xray-equivalent 'protocol: ["bittorrent"]' traffic-classification rule. Its closest native mechanisms are the 'network'/'protocol' sniffer fields plus 'process_name'/'package_name' rules on supported platforms, none of which reliably classify BitTorrent traffic the way Xray's built-in protocol sniffing does. This example applies the strongest supported policy instead: it enables sniffing and blocks by the 'protocol' condition where the sniffer can label a connection 'bittorrent', but it does not claim full parity with Xray's dedicated BitTorrent detection. Tracker-domain categories (see the 'trackers' rule_set) are an additional layer, not a replacement for protocol detection.

rules._comment: 1. Private/local domains and IP traffic to DIRECT via the generated private rule set and sing-box's native ip_is_private condition.
2. BitTorrent-labeled traffic to BLOCK using sing-box's connection sniffer. See _bittorrent_parity_comment: this is the strongest supported approximation, not full parity with Xray's protocol rule.
3. spy and ads categories to BLOCK.
4. Example service categories (google, youtube) routed to the node-example placeholder inter-node outbound. Replace node-example before deployment.
Trusted RU and Russia-only traffic to DIRECT, matching the shared lite/server policy base.

route._final_comment: 5. Unmatched traffic to DIRECT: the server dataset runs on the egress node itself, so a conservative PROXY-style default would misroute the node's own general traffic. Exceptions are handled by the explicit BLOCK rule_sets and named service outbounds above.

outbounds._comment: Optional additional upstream outbound for this deployment; not used by the default server policy above.

PLACEHOLDER outbound tag for deployment-specific inter-node routing. Replace address/credentials with a real node address/credentials before deployment. Used above to route a small representative subset of service categories.
